# Bundled demo startup repair

- demofix.js: NewTanachot/cs2-faceit-demo-fixer, commit 6627fbce1d6ea3f94f604576720602d41006337b (unmodified). MIT license in LICENSE.
- qjs.exe: official QuickJS-ng v0.18.0 Windows x86_64 release, https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs/releases/download/v0.18.0/qjs-windows-x86_64.exe

- run.js: FACEIT Voice adapter. Runs only this bundled repair library; demo bytes are read as data, never evaluated as code. Text sanitization is disabled. Input data is not uploaded. No Node.js installation is required.
